listenings.text: Good evening, and thank you for calling Le Petit Bistro. We are open every day, from twelve to eleven. Tonight we have three specials: onion soup, chicken with potatoes, and chocolate cake. If you would like a table for a big family, please call before six o'clock, because our restaurant is very small. There are only twelve tables inside. Water is free at every table in France, and service is included in the bill. If you have a question about the menu, we have a menu in English. Ask for it, and we bring it to your table. Thank you, and see you tonight.

Hello, and good evening. My name is Claire, and I work at the reception of your hotel. This is a short message about dinner tonight. There is a very good bistro on this street, only two minutes from the hotel. For three people, I recommend a table at seven thirty, because at nine o'clock it is very busy. The menu is in French and in English, so you can read it easily. And one small thing: coffee in France is very small. If you would like a big one, ask for a coffee with hot water. Service is in the bill, so a tip is not necessary. Have a very good dinner with your family.

reading.rtitle: Le Petit Bistro -- A Note for Our Guests
paras: Welcome to Le Petit Bistro. We are a small family restaurant on Rue de Rivoli, next to your hotel. This note answers the five questions our guests ask every night.
There is a menu in French and a menu in English. Ask for it: "Can I have the menu in English, please?" We are happy to bring it to your table.
There are twelve tables inside and four tables outside. For a family of three or more, please ask for a table before eight o'clock, because after eight the restaurant is very busy.

Water is free in France. Ask for a carafe of water and we bring it to your table with the bread. Coffee here is very small: it is an espresso. If you would like a big one, ask for a coffee with hot water.
Service is included in the bill. A tip is not necessary in France, but one or two euros on the table is always a nice thank you.
reading.source: Le Petit Bistro -- 14 Rue de Rivoli, Paris
